title.de: Präpositionen: in, on, under, next to
title.sl: Predlogi: in, on, under, next to
title.it: Le preposizioni: in, on, under, next to

goal.sl: Poveš, kje kaj je (in, on, under, behind, in front of, next to, between, at), vprašaš Where's …? in poveš, kam greš (go to the inn, go home).
goal.de: Du sagst, wo etwas ist (in, on, under, behind, in front of, next to, between, at), fragst Where's …? und sagst, wohin du gehst (go to the inn, go home).
goal.it: Dici dove si trova qualcosa (in, on, under, behind, in front of, next to, between, at), chiedi Where's …? e dici dove vai (go to the inn, go home).
goal.en: You can say where things and people are (in, on, under, behind, in front of, next to, between, at), ask Where's …? and say where you go (go to the inn, go home).

say.sl: **in** pomeni v, znotraj: **in the kitchen** (v kuhinji), **in the box** (v škatli), tudi za kraj in državo: **in Keswick**, **in England** (v Angliji). **on** pomeni na, na površini: **on the table** (na mizi), **on the wall** (na steni), **on the fell** (na hribu). Samostalnik se za predlogom nikoli ne spremeni, sklonov ni: **the table**, **on the table**.
say.de: **in** heißt in, drinnen: **in the kitchen** (in der Küche), **in the box** (in der Schachtel), auch für Orte und Länder: **in Keswick**, **in England**. **on** heißt auf, an einer Fläche: **on the table** (auf dem Tisch), **on the wall** (an der Wand), **on the fell** (auf dem Berg). Das Nomen ändert sich danach nie, einen Dativ gibt es nicht: **the table**, **on the table**.
say.it: **in** vuol dire dentro: **in the kitchen** (in cucina), **in the box** (nella scatola), e anche per città e paesi: **in Keswick** (a Keswick), **in England** (in Inghilterra). **on** vuol dire su, sopra una superficie: **on the table** (sul tavolo), **on the wall** (sul muro), **on the fell** (sul monte). Dopo la preposizione il nome non cambia mai: **the table**, **on the table**.
say.en: **in** is inside something: **in the kitchen**, **in the box**, and in a town or a country: **in Keswick**, **in England**. **on** is on top of a surface: **on the table**, **on the wall**, **on the fell**. The noun after them never changes: **the table**, **on the table**.

say.sl: **under** pomeni pod: **under the table** (pod mizo), **under the bridge** (pod mostom). **behind** pomeni za, zadaj: **behind the inn** (za gostilno). **in front of** so tri besede in pomenijo pred: **in front of the school** (pred šolo). Brez **of** ne gre.
say.de: **under** heißt unter: **under the table** (unter dem Tisch), **under the bridge** (unter der Brücke). **behind** heißt hinter: **behind the inn** (hinter dem Gasthaus). **in front of** sind drei Wörter und heißen vor: **in front of the school** (vor der Schule). Das **of** fehlt nie.
say.it: **under** vuol dire sotto: **under the table** (sotto il tavolo), **under the bridge** (sotto il ponte). **behind** vuol dire dietro: **behind the inn** (dietro la locanda). **in front of** sono tre parole e vogliono dire davanti a: **in front of the school** (davanti alla scuola). Senza **of** non va.
say.en: **under** is below: **under the table**, **under the bridge**. **behind** is at the back: **behind the inn**. **in front of** is three words, the opposite of behind: **in front of the school**. Never leave out **of**.

say.sl: **next to** pomeni zraven, tik ob: **next to the inn** (zraven gostilne). **between** pomeni med dvema: **between the inn and the church** (med gostilno in cerkvijo). **near** pomeni blizu: **near the beck** (blizu potoka). Tudi **by** je tik ob, pogosto ob vodi ali ognju: **by the beck** (ob potoku), **by the fire** (ob ognju).
say.de: **next to** heißt neben: **next to the inn** (neben dem Gasthaus). **between** heißt zwischen: **between the inn and the church** (zwischen dem Gasthaus und der Kirche). **near** heißt in der Nähe von: **near the beck** (in der Nähe vom Bach). Auch **by** ist direkt daneben, oft am Wasser oder Feuer: **by the beck** (am Bach), **by the fire** (am Feuer).
say.it: **next to** vuol dire accanto a: **next to the inn** (accanto alla locanda). **between** vuol dire tra: **between the inn and the church** (tra la locanda e la chiesa). **near** vuol dire vicino a: **near the beck** (vicino al ruscello). Anche **by** è proprio accanto, spesso all'acqua o al fuoco: **by the beck** (lungo il ruscello), **by the fire** (accanto al fuoco).
say.en: **next to** is right beside: **next to the inn**. **between** has one thing on each side: **between the inn and the church**. **near** is not far: **near the beck**. **by** is right beside too, often by water or a fire: **by the beck**, **by the fire**.

say.sl: **at** je kraj kot točka ali kraj, kjer nekaj počneš: **at the inn** (v gostilni), **at the bus stop** (na postaji), **at the door** (pri vratih). Brez **the**: **at home** (doma), **at work** (v službi), **at school** (v šoli). Mesto ima **in**, nikoli at: **in Keswick**.
say.de: **at** ist ein Ort als Punkt oder wo man etwas tut: **at the inn** (im Gasthaus), **at the bus stop** (an der Haltestelle), **at the door** (an der Tür). Ohne **the**: **at home** (zu Hause), **at work** (in der Arbeit), **at school** (in der Schule). Eine Stadt hat **in**, nie at: **in Keswick**.
say.it: **at** è un luogo visto come un punto o dove fai qualcosa: **at the inn** (alla locanda), **at the bus stop** (alla fermata), **at the door** (alla porta). Senza **the**: **at home** (a casa), **at work** (al lavoro), **at school** (a scuola). Una città vuole **in**, mai at: **in Keswick** (a Keswick).
say.en: **at** is a place seen as a point, or where you do something: **at the inn**, **at the bus stop**, **at the door**. Without **the**: **at home**, **at work**, **at school**. A town takes **in**, never at: **in Keswick**.

say.sl: Vprašaš z **Where's …?** (kje je) za eno in **Where are …?** (kje so) za več: **Where's the key?** (Kje je ključ?) **It's on the table.** (Na mizi je.) **Where are the sheep?** (Kje so ovce?) **They're on the fell.** (Na hribu so.) S **there's** in **there are** poveš, kaj je kje: **There's a bench in front of the inn.** (Pred gostilno je klop.)
say.de: Du fragst mit **Where's …?** (wo ist) für eins und **Where are …?** (wo sind) für mehrere: **Where's the key?** (Wo ist der Schlüssel?) **It's on the table.** (Auf dem Tisch.) **Where are the sheep?** (Wo sind die Schafe?) **They're on the fell.** (Auf dem Berg.) Mit **there's** und **there are** sagst du, was wo ist: **There's a bench in front of the inn.** (Vor dem Gasthaus steht eine Bank.)
say.it: Chiedi con **Where's …?** (dov'è) per una cosa e **Where are …?** (dove sono) per più cose: **Where's the key?** (Dov'è la chiave?) **It's on the table.** (È sul tavolo.) **Where are the sheep?** (Dove sono le pecore?) **They're on the fell.** (Sono sul monte.) Con **there's** e **there are** dici che cosa c'è in un posto: **There's a bench in front of the inn.** (Davanti alla locanda c'è una panchina.)
say.en: Ask with **Where's …?** (where is) for one, **Where are …?** for more: **Where's the key?** **It's on the table.** **Where are the sheep?** **They're on the fell.** With **there's** and **there are** you say what is in a place: **There's a bench in front of the inn.**

say.sl: Za kam greš je **to**: **go to the inn** (iti v gostilno), **the bus to Keswick** (avtobus za Keswick). A **home** je brez to: **go home** (iti domov), **come home** (priti domov). Noter je **into**: **Meg jumps into the beck.** (Meg skoči v potok.) Za kje nikoli to: **at the inn** (v gostilni).
say.de: Wohin du gehst, sagt **to**: **go to the inn** (ins Gasthaus gehen), **the bus to Keswick** (der Bus nach Keswick). Aber **home** ohne to: **go home** (nach Hause gehen), **come home** (nach Hause kommen). Hinein ist **into**: **Meg jumps into the beck.** (Meg springt in den Bach.) Für wo nie to: **at the inn** (im Gasthaus).
say.it: Per dove vai si usa **to**: **go to the inn** (andare alla locanda), **the bus to Keswick** (l'autobus per Keswick). Ma **home** senza to: **go home** (andare a casa), **come home** (tornare a casa). Dentro, con movimento, è **into**: **Meg jumps into the beck.** (Meg salta nel ruscello.) Per dove si trova, mai to: **at the inn** (alla locanda).
say.en: For where you go, use **to**: **go to the inn**, **the bus to Keswick**. But **home** takes no to: **go home**, **come home**. Going inside is **into**: **Meg jumps into the beck.** For where something is, never to: **at the inn**.

examples.en: We go to Keswick on the bus.
examples.de: Wir fahren mit dem Bus nach Keswick.

summary.sl: Kje: **in** v, znotraj, v kraju (**in the kitchen**, **in Keswick**); **on** na površini (**on the table**, **on the fell**); **at** točka ali kjer nekaj počneš (**at the inn**, **at home**, **at work**); **under** pod, **behind** za, **in front of** pred, **next to** in **by** zraven, **between** med, **near** blizu. Samostalnik se ne spremeni. Vprašaš **Where's …?** in **Where are …?** Kam: **to** (**go to the inn**), a **go home**; noter **into**.
summary.de: Wo: **in** drinnen, in einem Ort (**in the kitchen**, **in Keswick**); **on** auf einer Fläche (**on the table**, **on the fell**); **at** ein Punkt oder wo man etwas tut (**at the inn**, **at home**, **at work**); **under** unter, **behind** hinter, **in front of** vor, **next to** und **by** neben, **between** zwischen, **near** in der Nähe. Das Nomen bleibt gleich. Du fragst **Where's …?** und **Where are …?** Wohin: **to** (**go to the inn**), aber **go home**; hinein **into**.
summary.it: Dove: **in** dentro, in una città (**in the kitchen**, **in Keswick**); **on** su una superficie (**on the table**, **on the fell**); **at** un punto o dove fai qualcosa (**at the inn**, **at home**, **at work**); **under** sotto, **behind** dietro, **in front of** davanti a, **next to** e **by** accanto a, **between** tra, **near** vicino a. Il nome non cambia. Chiedi **Where's …?** e **Where are …?** Dove vai: **to** (**go to the inn**), ma **go home**; dentro **into**.
summary.en: Where: **in** inside, in a town (**in the kitchen**, **in Keswick**); **on** a surface (**on the table**, **on the fell**); **at** a point or where you do something (**at the inn**, **at home**, **at work**); **under**, **behind**, **in front of**, **next to**, **by**, **between**, **near**. The noun never changes. Ask **Where's …?** and **Where are …?** Where to: **to** (**go to the inn**), but **go home**; going inside: **into**.

exercises.text: The Packhorse Inn is ___ the bridge and the church. There's a big map of the fells ___ the wall. Mrs Birkett is ___ the kitchen. The bus stop is in ___ of the inn, and the smithy is next ___ the inn. Mr Dixon isn't ___ home. He's ___ work in the smithy.

translation.sl: Gostilna Packhorse je med mostom in cerkvijo. Na steni je velik zemljevid hribov. Gospa Birkett je v kuhinji. Avtobusna postaja je pred gostilno, kovačnica pa zraven gostilne. Gospoda Dixona ni doma. V službi je, v kovačnici.
translation.de: Das Packhorse Inn ist zwischen der Brücke und der Kirche. An der Wand hängt eine große Karte der Berge. Mrs Birkett ist in der Küche. Die Bushaltestelle ist vor dem Gasthaus, und die Schmiede ist neben dem Gasthaus. Mr Dixon ist nicht zu Hause. Er ist in der Arbeit, in der Schmiede.
translation.it: Il Packhorse Inn è tra il ponte e la chiesa. Sul muro c'è una grande cartina dei monti. Mrs Birkett è in cucina. La fermata dell'autobus è davanti alla locanda e la fucina è accanto alla locanda. Mr Dixon non è a casa. È al lavoro, nella fucina.
translation.en: The Packhorse Inn is between the bridge and the church. There's a big map of the fells on the wall. Mrs Birkett is in the kitchen. The bus stop is in front of the inn, and the smithy is next to the inn. Mr Dixon isn't at home. He's at work in the smithy.

translation.sl: Kje je stari Wilf? Ni doma. V gostilni je, zraven ognja. Njegova stara psička Bess je pod mizo. Wilfova hišica je med mlinom in potokom, njegova klop pa pred hišico.

translation.it: Dov'è il vecchio Wilf? Non è a casa. È alla locanda, accanto al fuoco. La sua vecchia cagna Bess è sotto il tavolo. La casetta di Wilf è tra il mulino e il ruscello, e la sua panchina è davanti alla casetta.
translation.en: Where's Old Wilf? He isn't at home. He's at the inn, next to the fire. His old dog Bess is under the table. Wilf's cottage is between the mill and the beck, and his bench is in front of the cottage.
